versions.changelog: Emphasize personal-first reusable skill extraction, audience labels, and portability limits.
Improve similar-skill discovery using local search, skills.sh, npx skills find, query variants, and external quality signals.
Preserve language consistency for extracted skills and updates.
Tighten title selection so chosen or custom topics re-run extraction and similarity gates before drafting.
Add candidate title selection before full skill extraction, including none-of-these and custom-topic paths.
Require full proposed skill contents or complete update diffs before asking for user approval.
Refine candidate lifecycle, evidence and value gates, background extraction, and confirmation workflow.
Initial standalone release of the AutoSkill local skill manager.
